Estimated taxes aren’t just for the self-employed Tax Tip 2026-69 Sept. 14, 2026 — Typically, people who are self-employed pay their federal income tax by making estimated tax payments. Taxpayers have the right to retain representation Tax Tip 2026-68 Sept. 9, 2026 — When working with the IRS, all taxpayers have the right to retain an authorized representative of their choice to act on their behalf. How taxpayers can reconstruct records after a disaster Tax Tip 2026-67, Sept. 2, 2026 — Some taxpayers may need to reconstruct vital records that were lost in a disaster.
